scenario_summary: Customer needs to recover account access without original contact details to process a refund for an unknown order.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Diego Martinez and I'm 66. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello, Mr. Martinez. I understand how frustrating it is to be locked out of your account, especially when you are away from your usual devices. For your security, I cannot access account details by name alone, as our Privacy and Data Protection Policy requires at least two unique identifiers to verify ownership. Could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the credit card used for the purchase?
Oh, I see. My address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you for providing those details. I have successfully located your profile using that information. Regarding the refund you mentioned, our records show a transaction for $45.00 on October 12th. Is that the specific order you are looking to have refunded?
Yes, that sounds like the one. I believe I was charged twice for the same item.

I see the duplicate charge in our system. Per our Billing Accuracy Policy, I have initiated a full refund for that second charge. You should see the credit reflected on your statement within 3-5 business days. As a gesture of goodwill for the inconvenience, I have also applied a $10 credit to your account for future use.
That is very helpful, thank you. Can you also help me update the email on my account so I don't have this trouble next time?
Certainly. Since we have verified your identity, I can assist with that. Please provide the new email address you would like to use, and I will update your account settings immediately.

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer using billing address and partial card details, identified the duplicate charge, processed the refund, and provided a goodwill credit.

judge_scores.justification: The agent appropriately verified the customer using two unique identifiers per privacy policy without being overly burdensome, while showing genuine empathy for the customer's lockout situation. Furthermore, the agent efficiently resolved the duplicate charge issue within their authority and correctly cited relevant billing and privacy policies.
